subject: FinHealth — Private/VPC discovery recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@finhealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>; Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>

Subject: FinHealth — Private/VPC discovery recap & next steps

Hi Alice — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call so we have aligned expectations and next steps.

What we heard (pain & constraints)
- Regulated PHI workloads: HIPAA-covered; must enforce data residency controls and produce audit trails.
- Customer-managed keys: must integrate with FinHealth KMS/HSM (AWS KMS CMKs + CloudHSM preferred) and support key rotation policies.
- Network constraints: no outbound internet from model-serving hosts in some envs; egress must go through approved NAT/proxy.
- Air-gap requirement on select deployments: some customers will require an offline deployment option for validation and certification.
- Logging/audit: immutable audit logs retained for 7 years; access logs must be exportable to your SIEM.

Current stack you shared
- AWS (us-east-1) with dedicated VPCs per environment
- In-house KMS with CMKs and existing CloudHSM cluster
- Internal model orchestration using Kubernetes + strict egress rules

Success criteria for POC
- Private/VPC deployment that can be deployed into a FinHealth VPC with no public egress from model hosts
- Ability to use customer-managed keys for data-at-rest and encrypt logs with your CMK
- Demonstrable audit logs and access controls (single-tenant or dedicated)
- Performance target: 95th percentile latency under 200ms for typical inference calls for the demo load (we discussed sample qps)

Attachments shared
- FinHealth_Security_Questionnaire.pdf (your initial security questionnaire)
- network_diagram.png (your rough network sketch that we used during the call)

Proposed next steps
1) I will share our HIPAA/BAA summary and SOC2 report excerpts (by EOD).
2) FinHealth to share the more detailed network diagram and a copy of your KMS key policy (Raj mentioned gating policies) — you said by COB Monday.
3) Internal: Aditya/Vivek — can you validate feasibility of CloudHSM integration and offline deployment flow? We think we have two approaches: 1) deployment with VPC endpoints + NAT-proxied egress restrictions, or 2) fully air-gapped node bundle for on-prem validation.
4) Schedule a technical deep-dive next week to go over the network/firewall and key integration (30–45 minutes).

Please reply if I missed anything or if any of the items below need correction. Happy to adjust timeline.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa — this is great and captures the conversation. A few clarifications and items from our side:

Clarifications
- HIPAA/BAA: yes, FinHealth requires a signed BAA for any provider processing PHI. Please send your standard BAA and high-level SOC2 artifacts (control descriptions are fine).
- KMS/HSM: we use AWS KMS with CMKs in a restricted account; CloudHSM is available for key material in some workloads. We need a plan for key import vs. key-wrapping — our security team prefers keys we control and never exported.
- Air-gap: for the most sensitive datasets we will want an air-gapped validation environment. Not all customer tenants need this, but the POC should demonstrate the capability.
- Network: hosts that perform inference must not egress directly to the public internet. We can provide a bastion/NAT or VPC endpoint configuration.

Deliverables from FinHealth by Monday
- Full network diagram (per your request)
- Key policy document (redacted) and contact for our security engineer (Raj)

Two asks from us
1) High-level ETA and resource ask: what engineering time do you expect for a POC (rough weeks) and whether you view Dedicated vs Private deployment as the recommended path?
2) Ballpark pricing: we need an estimated cost for a POC (1–2 month) and for a 6-month dedicated environment to present to procurement.

Attached is a short spreadsheet with some additional compliance notes: finhealth_requirements.xlsx

Appreciate the quick turnaround on documents — I’ll coordinate with Raj on the network artifacts.

Best,

Alice Morgan
Director, Cloud Security | FinHealth
